{
  "findings": [
    {
      "ref": "[D541]",
      "area": "contact",
      "claim": "A parent reports that game chat can be turned off for users under 9.",
      "stance": "mitigation",
      "quote": "Users under the age of 9 require parental consent to enable game chat."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[D541]",
      "area": "contact",
      "claim": "A parent reports that direct chat requires parental consent for users under 13.",
      "stance": "mitigation",
      "quote": "Users under the age of 13 require parental consent to enable direct chat."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[D541]",
      "area": "contact",
      "claim": "A parent reports that party chat is only allowed between age checked users above 13 in similar age groups.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "Party chat is only allowed between age checked users above 13 in similar age groups."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[D541]",
      "area": "money",
      "claim": "A parent reports that spending notifications are sent after $100, $250, and $500 in a month.",
      "stance": "mitigation",
      "quote": "you should receive purchase notifications after $100, $250, and $500 of spend in a given month (or the equivalent in local currency)."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[D541]",
      "area": "data",
      "claim": "A parent reports that Roblox collects Robux balance information.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "You can view your child's Robux balance and add Robux to their account from Parental Controls."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[D541]",
      "area": "age_gating",
      "claim": "A parent reports that the age gate for sensitive issues requires toggling a selector on.",
      "stance": "mitigation",
      "quote": "Toggle the Allow sensitive issues selector ON to allow your child to access games that are primarily themed on sensitive issues."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[D541]",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "A parent reports that the Minimal label may contain occasional mild violence and light unrealistic blood.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "May contain occasional mild violence, light unrealistic blood, and/or occasional mild fear."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[D541]",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "A parent reports that the Restricted label may contain strong violence, heavy realistic blood, romantic themes, alcohol, strong language, and gambling content.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "May contain strong violence, heavy realistic blood, moderate crude humor, romantic themes, unplayable gambling content, the presence of alcohol, strong language, and/or moderate fear."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[D541]",
      "area": "blocking",
      "claim": "A parent reports that a game can be blocked by searching its name and selecting Block.",
      "stance": "mitigation",
      "quote": "Select the + icon. In the search bar, type the game name you want to block. Select Block and confirm."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[D541]",
      "area": "blocking",
      "claim": "A parent reports that blocking a game takes effect the next time the child enters it.",
      "stance": "mitigation",
      "quote": "If you block a game while your child is playing, the block will only take effect the next time they enter the game."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[D541]",
      "area": "blocking",
      "claim": "A parent reports that blocked games still appear in search results.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "Blocked games will still appear in search results."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[D541]",
      "area": "blocking",
      "claim": "A parent reports that blocked games can be unblocked by selecting Unblock.",
      "stance": "mitigation",
      "quote": "To unblock a game, click Unblock and confirm."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[D541]",
      "area": "blocking",
      "claim": "A parent reports that blocked games can be managed under Content restrictions > Allowed games.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "Review and manage your child’s allowed games via Content restrictions > Allowed games."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[D541]",
      "area": "blocking",
      "claim": "A parent reports that blocked games can be revoked by selecting the three-dot menu and choosing Don’t allow.",
      "stance": "mitigation",
      "quote": "To revoke approval for a game, select the three-dot menu next to the game title and select Don’t allow."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[D541]",
      "area": "blocking",
      "claim": "A parent reports that allowed games can be viewed in the Allowed games list.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "Allowed games will appear in the Allowed games list."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[D541]",
      "area": "blocking",
      "claim": "A parent reports that allowed games can be granted by selecting Allow in a request email.",
      "stance": "mitigation",
      "quote": "Select Allow or Don’t Allow to approve or deny the request."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[D541]",
      "area": "blocking",
      "claim": "A parent reports that allowed games can be managed in Pending requests.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "Navigate to Pending requests in your settings to see any allowed games requests."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[D541]",
      "area": "blocking",
      "claim": "A parent reports that blocked games can be unblocked by clicking Unblock.",
      "stance": "mitigation",
      "quote": "To unblock a game, click Unblock and confirm."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[D541]",
      "area": "blocking",
      "claim": "A parent reports that blocked games can be blocked again by selecting Block.",
      "stance": "mitigation",
      "quote": "Select Block and confirm."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[D541]",
      "area": "blocking",
      "claim": "A parent reports that blocked games can be blocked for any content maturity level.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "Block a game to prevent your child from accessing it, regardless of its content maturity level."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[D541]",
      "area": "blocking",
      "claim": "A parent reports that blocked games can be blocked via the Blocked games setting.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "Select Blocked games and select the + icon."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[D541]",
      "area": "blocking",
      "claim": "A parent reports that blocked games can be blocked by searching the game name.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "In the search bar, type the game name you want to block."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[D541]",
